The '''''Ziost Shadow''''', named after the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]], was a [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] that served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR" /> It was [[Darth Nurin]]'s personal flagship from which she conducted operations during the [[Tion Hegemony rakghoul outbreak|Tion Hegemony crisis]].<ref name="tion hegemony">{{TORcite|type=other|Imperial storyline "Trouble in the Tion Hegemony"}}</ref>

==Description==
Ziost Shadow had an extensive public space accommodated for visits of ambassadors representing various third parties aside from the Sith Empire; most notably from [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]]<ref name="titans">{{TORcite|type=other|Imperial storyline "Titans of Industry"}}</ref> and [[Gree Enclave/Legends|Gree Enclave]].<ref name="New Frontiers">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|New Frontiers|Ziost Shadow}}</ref> Public area of the ship featured general goods shops, such as the one run by [[Adon-larr]], while the walls there were used to alert against an infamous [[Unidentified hammerheaded fugitive|alien fugitive]] via multiple "wanted" posters.<ref name="TOR" />
[[File:DatacronMuseumZiostShadow-SWTOR.png|left|thumb|[[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Datacron/Legends|Datacrons]] in the Ziost Shadow museum]]
The ship also had a museum with pavilions dedicated to the History of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] and Natural Wonders - [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] of the [[The galaxy/Legends|Galaxy]]. Notable exhibits included [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Datacron/Legends|Datacrons]], [[Krayt dragon/Legends|Krayt Dragon]]'s skull, an ancient statue from [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]<ref name"Corellia">{{TORcite|type=other|"Corellian Museum Crystal", broken part of the statue featured on Ziost Shadow found on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]}}</ref> and fully functional examples of an old-fashioned Imperial [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] and a Republican [[Manka-class armored transport|Mobile Medicine walker]].<ref name="TOR" />

==History==
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Ziost Shadow orbited [[Vaiken Spacedock]]. It served a staging ground for many Imperial military activities, such as the suppression of [[Directive 7]]. Among the Imperial command stationed on Ziost Shadow was [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Altiss]],<ref name="TOR" /> as well as Moff [[Kresk]], when he was coordinating [[seizure of CZ-198]] during the reorganization of [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]],<ref name="titans" /> and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Threnoldt]], who assembled strike teams on board of the ship before sending them to the [[Eternity Vault]].<ref name="Eternity">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Eternity Vault|Ziost Shadow}}</ref>

In [[3639 BBY]]<ref name="Date 1.1">{{TOR_updates|1.1}}</ref>, during the [[Tion Hegemony rakghoul outbreak|rakghoul crisis]] in [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]], Ziost Shadow functioned as [[Darth Nurin]]'s personal flagship, from which she conducted operations to [[Kaon]] and [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantel]], to avert the potential galactic disaster and seize any available scientific data concerning the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|plague]] for the Empire.<ref name="tion hegemony" />

A [[3638 BBY|year later]],<ref name="Date 2.4">{{TOR_updates|2.4}}</ref> Ziost Shadow came under the command of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Varnus Orlec]], who organized a [[Battle of Darvannis|mission]] to [[Darvannis|Darvanis]] from the ship.<ref name="Scum">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|The Legions of Scum and Villainy|Ziost Shadow}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Ziost Shadow'' first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. It serves as a flashpoint and operation starting area for Imperial players.<ref name="TOR" /> In quests preceding flashpoint "Kaon under Siege" and an operation "Scum and Villainy", both [[Darth Nurin]] and [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Varnus Orlec|Orlec]] refer to Ziost Shadow as to their personal ship,<ref name="tion hegemony" /><ref name="Scum" /> though in the game timeline these interactions happen almost a year apart.<ref name="Date 1.1" /><ref name="Date 2.4" /> 
[[File:NoDisintegrations-SWTOR.png|thumb|"No Disintegrations"]]
The museum on Ziost Shadow features an elaborate hidden quest to obtain the [[Datacron/Legends|Datacron]] associated with the fleet, which requires cooperation of several players. A piece of the ancient statue from the museum, which is needed to advance in the quest, can be found on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], in a crate with several artifacts similar to those on Ziost Shadow, such as a smaller [[Krayt dragon/Legends|Krayt dragon]] skull; suggesting that some of the museum exhibits, including the statue itself, were brought to the ship from Corellia. A similar quest is available for Republic players on [[Gav Daragon (Valor-class)|Gav Daragon]]. The bridge of the Ziost Shadow features a scene referencing the "No disintegrations" scene from the [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|Empire Strikes Back]], with a masked Sith instructing several familiar looking bounty hunters.<ref name="TOR" />
